identity.en: a slender eighteen-year-old European woman from a fairy-tale kingdom, an oppressed stepdaughter who carries herself with quiet grace
identity.text: 约十八岁的欧洲童话王国少女，受压迫的继女，举止优雅隐忍

face.en: a gentle oval face with large soft golden-brown eyes that hold a faint sorrow, fine delicate features
face.text: 柔和鹅蛋脸，大眼温柔带愁，五官精致

hair.en: long soft golden-blonde hair falling in loose waves past the shoulders
hair.text: 柔金长发，松散波浪垂至肩下

build.en: a slender, graceful figure of medium height
build.text: 身形纤细优雅，中等身高

top.en: the fitted pale-blue bodice of a ball gown with delicate silver embroidery and thin shoulder straps
top.text: 浅蓝舞会礼裙上身，缀银线刺绣，细肩带

bottom.en: the long flowing pale-blue skirt of the ball gown with a silver-embroidered hem
bottom.text: 浅蓝舞会礼裙长摆，下摆缀银线刺绣

details.en: a single crystal slipper on one foot while the other foot stays bare
details.text: 一只脚穿水晶鞋、另一只赤足

details.en: soft golden waves gathered with a small ribbon at the side
details.text: 柔金波浪发，侧边缀小缎带

look.style: A clean 2D Japanese anime illustration, like official character art for a TV anime: crisp confident line art of even weight, cel shading with one soft shadow tone and a few sharp highlights, flat clean colors, anime-style eyes with clear highlights, a small simplified nose and mouth, hair drawn in smooth clumps with glossy highlight bands. Fabric folds drawn as simple lines.
look.clean: Plain pure white background, evenly lit, with at most a faint soft shadow under the feet. Exactly one character, empty hands, no props, no text, no watermark.
look.neg: photograph, photorealistic, realistic skin texture, pores, film grain, 3D render, CGI, semi-realistic, painterly, watercolor, sketch, rough lines, messy lines, heavy shading, gradient background, character sheet, multiple views, chibi, super deformed
